mapper.sql: a.id,a.project_id,p.project_name,'PARAMETER' AS asset_type,a.parameter_name AS asset_code,a.parameter_name AS asset_name,a.parameter_type,a.parameter_scope,a.system_code,sys.name AS system_name,a.parameter_description,a.owner_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.deleted_by,a.deleted_at

FROM dm_parameter a LEFT JOIN dm_component c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.project_id=a.project_id AND c.system_code=a.system_code LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem sys ON sys.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND sys.code=c.system_code AND sys.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON a.project_id=p.id AND p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0

WHERE a.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{p.projectId} AND a.deleted=#{p.deleted} AND a.parameter_type=#{p.parameterType} AND a.parameter_scope=#{p.parameterScope} AND a.system_code=#{p.systemCode} AND (a.parameter_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%') OR a.parameter_description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY a.parameter_name ASC,a.id ASCa.updated_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=0
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=1

SELECT id,tenant_id,project_id,system_code,parameter_type,parameter_scope,parameter_name,parameter_description,owner_id FROM dm_parameter WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=#{deleted}
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_parameter SET parameter_type=#{p.parameterType},parameter_scope=#{p.parameterScope},system_code=#{p.systemCode},parameter_name=#{p.parameterName},parameter_description=#{p.parameterDescription},updated_by=#{p.updatedBy},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{p.id} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_parameter SET deleted=1,deleted_by=#{actorId},deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_parameter SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_parameter WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_parameter WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND system_code=#{systemCode} AND parameter_name=#{parameterName} AND deleted=0 AND id != #{excludeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND system_code=#{systemCode} AND enabled=1
SELECT project_id FROM dm_parameter WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
